source.name: Tab must leave a datepicker input for the next field, and a click must still show the calendar
source.scope: Open upstream bug (https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/issues/43202) at 2bb544eb426e9b1e019c2a98798e0002b8a41d35, unfixed when pinned. Routing Super, then Ultra.

journey.title: Tab out of the departure date to the passengers field
journey.goal: Tab moves focus from the date field to the next field, as in any form

functionalJourney.title: Change the passengers with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Editing another field and saving submits the saved departure date

guards.title: Escape still closes the calendar
guards.goal: With the calendar open, Escape closes it and Tab then reaches the passengers field

guards.title: Clicking the date field still shows the calendar
guards.goal: A pointer user who clicks the departure date sees the month and can pick a day

plan.root_cause: The datepicker component shows a popup on focus via the focusin data API listener. When the popup is shown, it prevents the default action of the Tab key on the input, trapping focus in the input and preventing navigation to the next field.
plan.repair_strategy: Remove the focusin data API listener that shows the datepicker on focus, and modify the click listener to work for inputs (removing the early return for inputs). This ensures the datepicker only toggles on click, allowing Tab to move focus naturally when the datepicker is not shown.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Tab key will move focus from the departure date field to the passengers field when the datepicker is not shown (i.e., when navigating via Tab), restoring the natural tab order of the form.
functional_risks: Users who rely on the datepicker showing on focus (e.g., keyboard users who tab into the field) will no longer see the datepicker automatically; they must click to show it.
This changes the interaction model from focus-triggered to click-triggered for the datepicker popup.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Tab moves focus from the departure date field to the passengers field when the datepicker is not shown.
Verify that clicking the departure date field shows the datepicker popup.
Verify that pressing Escape hides the datepicker popup when it is shown.
Verify that date selection still functions correctly (e.g., selecting a date updates the input value and hides the popup for single selection mode).
